newsitem.title: USA: Bandag sees difficulty posting '97 EPS rise.
newsitem.headline: Bandag sees difficulty posting '97 EPS rise.

text.p: Bandag Inc, which makes retreading materials and equipment, said Thursday it will be difficult for it to post higher earnings for 1997.
In 1996 it earned $81.6 million, or $3.44 a share.

"Given the aggressive development plans and timetable our organization has committed to, I know it will be difficult to achieve increased earnings for the full year 1997," Martin Carver, chairman, said in a statement.
Bandag today reported lower second quarter earnings despite a rise in sales.
"As expected, net earnings were lower due to the higher level of operating expenses related to development work on our strategic initiatives," Carver said.
He said sales of Bandag's new application-specific tire products are exceeding forecast.
